content:
{
  "findings": [
    {
      "title": "Primary endpoint definition lacks time frame and confirmation details",
      "quote": "The primary endpoint is ORR, defined as the proportion of subjects with a confirmed objective response of CR or PR based on Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors version 1.1 (RECIST v1.1).",
      "page": 46,
      "section": "2.2.1",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The definition does not specify the time window for response assessment (e.g., from first dose) or the minimum duration for confirmation, which is critical for the estimand and analysis.",
      "fix": "Add a time frame (e.g., 'from first dose to end of treatment') and specify confirmation criteria (e.g., 'confirmed by repeat imaging at least 4 weeks later')."
    },
    {
      "title": "Inconsistent use of 'PD-1–blocking antibody' with double hyphen",
      "quote": "Cohort C2: Subjects who have progressed while receiving a PD-1–-blocking antibody or within 12 weeks of discontinuation",
      "page": 48,
      "section": "3.1",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "The text contains a typographical error with a double hyphen ('PD-1–-blocking'), which may cause confusion and is inconsistent with other occurrences.",
      "fix": "Change to 'PD-1–blocking antibody' (single hyphen)."
    },
    {
      "title": "Contraception requirements not specified",
      "quote": "The secondary objectives of the study are to: • Evaluate the safety and tolerability of vidutolimod administered by IT injection in combination with cemiplimab",
      "page": 46,
      "section": "2.1.2",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "critical",
      "explanation": "The protocol lacks any contraception requirements for participants, which is essential for a study involving investigational drugs with potential teratogenicity.",
      "fix": "Add a dedicated section on contraception requirements, including acceptable methods and duration for males and females."
    },
    {
      "title": "No explicit trial stopping rules",
      "quote": "All subjects will receive vidutolimod and cemiplimab according to the treatment schedule up to 2 years or until a reason for treatment discontinuation is reached.",
      "page": 49,
      "section": "3.1",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The protocol does not describe any trial-level stopping rules (e.g., for safety or futility), which are required for early termination decisions.",
      "fix": "Add a section on trial stopping rules, including criteria for halting the trial due to safety concerns or lack of efficacy."
    },
    {
      "title": "Inconsistent imaging interval: text says every 9 weeks, schema says Q12W",
      "quote": "Disease status will be assessed by computed tomography (CT) or magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) and other appropriate measures beginning predose at Week 10 Day 1 (W10D1) and will be repeated every 9 weeks (e.g. W19D1, W28D1, etc.)",
      "page": 49,
      "section": "3.1",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The text states imaging every 9 weeks, but the schema (Figure 1) indicates Q12W (every 12 weeks). This discrepancy could lead to protocol deviations.",
      "fix": "Align the text and schema to a single interval (e.g., every 9 weeks or every 12 weeks) and correct the schema abbreviation."
    },
    {
      "title": "No description of post-trial access to treatment",
      "quote": "At the end of the treatment period (2 years), the Sponsor will not continue to provide supplied study treatment to subjects/investigators unless the Sponsor chooses to extend the study.",
      "page": 49,
      "section": "3.1",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The protocol states that the sponsor will not continue providing treatment after 2 years, but does not describe any alternative access program or arrangements for continued treatment, which is a key ethical and practical consideration.",
      "fix": "Add a section on post-trial access, including whether an extension or compassionate use program is available."
    },
    {
      "title": "No details on sample size determination",
      "quote": "This is a multicenter, open-label, Phase 2 clinical study of vidutolimod administered by IT injection in combination with cemiplimab IV in subjects with selected types of advanced or metastatic cancer",
      "page": 48,
      "section": "3.1",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "critical",
      "explanation": "The protocol does not provide any information on how the sample size was determined, including assumptions for ORR, power, or alpha. This is essential for evaluating the trial's validity.",
      "fix": "Add a sample size determination section with statistical assumptions and calculations for each cohort."
    },
    {
      "title": "No mention of data monitoring committee or interim analyses",
      "quote": "The secondary objectives of the study are to: • Evaluate the safety and tolerability of vidutolimod administered by IT injection in combination with cemiplimab",
      "page": 46,
      "section": "2.1.2",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The protocol lacks any description of a data monitoring committee (DMC) or interim analyses, which are important for safety monitoring in a Phase 2 study with multiple cohorts.",
      "fix": "Add sections on trial oversight, including DMC charter and any planned interim analyses."
    }
  ]
}
